required_checks: Reject missing/unknown schema or any non-false release_authorized in a blocked staging inventory.
Verify all data/base/candidate/parent/report/local-evidence hashes and exact source set, unique row counts, selected-ID digests and inherited source coverage.

Reject any review_required/restricted/unknown rights decision, absent human approval receipt, unresolved generator/rightsholder/privacy issue, or stale receipt before any publication eligibility claim.
A human decision needs scope, reviewer identity/role, date and hash-bound evidence; presence of an assertion or license metadata is not an approval.
Verify all three human returns and exact packet binding; independently inspect attestation and per-row language/reviewer assignment coverage.
Verify MIT/base and data-attribution notices in the pack, and fail if any distributed material lacks its applicable notice.
Restrict pack content to an explicit allowlist; no raw training/audit/sealed text, credentials, optimizer/training_args pickle, or unlisted source URLs.
Keep quality/final-validation/runtime/package checks separate; passing provenance never overrides failed quality gates.
Never contact publishers, authenticate or upload as a side effect of validation.
